column_mapping_basis: BASIC field expressions and ordinal HVR declarations plus dbt SQL projections/schema; graph fragments alone do not establish column mappings.

account_scope.selection_rule: All product directories in kb-cdp-tenant-account plus all production kb-accounts projects, EF snapshots, and event schemas captured; no source checkout outside the two-repository allowlist.
account_scope.software_scope: kb-accounts project references are retained separately from its data/event lineage.
account_scope.field_scope: Explicit EF property bindings, C# entity-to-event assignments, and SQL projections; unresolved transformations and transport remain visible.
